'''Club Ufora''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] and club located in the sprawling city [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. Located in the [[Red Light Sector (Nar Shaddaa)|Red Light Sector]] of Nar Shaddaa's underground, Club Ufora was one of the seedier establishments on the moon. In the year [[3643 BBY]], a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]-allied individual discovered that the back area of Club Ufora had several [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] crates. After investigating further, the hero found out that the Republic's [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Rale]] was being held captive. He informed the hero that several other officers had been taken captive as well. He thought that it was possible that the other captive officers could have been held in the [[Quarantine Zone (Nar Shaddaa)|Quarantine Zone]]. His supposition proved right, and Club Ufora's operation was shut down.
